in_marathi.name: Haresh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Sun, Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haresh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Haresh is a name of the Hindu god, Surya, who represents the sun and its power. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'hari' meaning 'shining, radiant' and 'rishabh' meaning 'strong, powerful'.
